scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,client -c blue,green,cyan "npm run dev --workspace @react-quest/shared" "npm run dev --workspace @react-quest/server" "npm run dev --workspace @react-quest/client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @react-quest/shared && npm run build --workspace @react-quest/client --workspace @react-quest/server
scripts.build:client: npm run build --workspace @react-quest/shared && npm run build --workspace @react-quest/client
scripts.build:server: npm run build --workspace @react-quest/shared && npm run build --workspace @react-quest/server
